impact: The pre-registered mechanical scorer checked expected calculation objects but did not compare the prose against them; its H02 mechanical_pass result must not be interpreted as numerical correctness of the full answer.
verification: Detected by comparing the retained model output and program calculation; the result is not a blinded or independent human assessment.
handling: Original frozen inputs, outputs, score and failed H03 record are preserved; no repeat call or re-scoring of this holdout was performed. Product code was subsequently changed to flag a limited set of potentially mismatching percentages for review.
